commands.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const d="docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24";for(const n of ["world-theory-draft.md","world-rule-design.md"]){const f=path.join(d,n),s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");for(const m of s.matchAll(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/g)){const t=m[1].split("#")[0];if(t&&!t.includes("://")&&!fs.existsSync(path.resolve(path.dirname(f),t)))throw Error(f+" -> "+t)}}console.log("two-document relative links OK")'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),d="docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24/",w=fs.readFileSync(d+"world-theory-draft.md","utf8"),r=fs.readFileSync("docs/reference/meta-spells.md","utf8");let names=[];for(const h of ["运算符（30）","按键状态（4）","状态探查（36）","实体创建（1）","实体控制（22）","施法控制（1）"]){const section=r.split("## "+h)[1]?.split("\n## ")[0];if(!section)throw Error("section "+h);for(const line of section.split("\n")){const m=line.match(/^\| ([^|]+) \|/);if(m&&!m[1].includes("元法术")&&!m[1].startsWith("--"))names.push(m[1].trim())}}const missing=names.filter(n=>!w.includes("`"+n+"`"));console.log({count:names.length,missing});if(names.length!==94||missing.length)process.exit(1)'
